messages:
Jules M: Escalating NimbleAI onboarding to CS as P1. Renewal in ~25 days and the customer cannot go live. Sharing quick context below.

Priya K: Short summary: after a recent model swap the ingestion backfill is failing for ~8% of documents (checksum/embedding mismatch). SSO auth intermittently returns 403 for some users. Ingestion latency spikes during backfills in eu-west-2.

Omar S: Logs/snippet: INGEST_FAIL batch=bf-2026-04-01-09 count=76, error=embedding_checksum_mismatch, node=eu-west-2/gpu-3 latency_ms=1875, SSO token exchange 403 at auth-proxy-07. Config: model=open-embed-v2, quant=q4_1, batch_size=64.

Tanya (AE): Customer is anxious about the renewal; asked for daily updates and a firm ETA to go-live. They're available for a triage call within 45 minutes.

Jules M: Proposed comms plan: 1) Ack email within 15m naming CS single POC (Priya). 2) 0-48h: daily 20-min triage calls until backfill progress >95%. 3) 48h-7d: daily async updates and two 30-min check-ins if needed. 4) Deliver a quantified postmortem + mitigation before renewal.

Priya K: Customer-facing bullets to paste: Who: Priya (CS lead), Omar (Support eng), Jules (AM), Tanya (AE). What: triage embeddings drift, complete backfill, validate SSO, mitigate latency. When: ack now, triage call in 45m, daily updates. How we'll measure: backfill success %, avg ingest latency, SSO error rate. Temporary mitigations: rollback to open-embed-v1, reduce batch_size to 16 for backfill, route ingestion to eu-central-1 if eu-west-2 remains degraded.

Omar S: Minimal rollback runbook to paste: 1) pin model to open-embed-v1 on ingest cluster, 2) run backfill in small batches (batch_size=16), 3) monitor recall delta using sample check. Command: python tools/embed_diff.py --old open-embed-v1 --new open-embed-v2 --sample 5000.

Jules M: I will draft the ack email. Tanya, please confirm youll surface exec concerns if this hits renewal.

Tanya (AE): Will do. I'll join triage and follow with the customer exec note after our call.

cs-bot: Reminder created 6 triage call in 45 minutes (invite sent).

Priya K: Action items (short): Omar - collect failing doc IDs and paste sample in thread; Omar - paste rollback steps to runbook; Jules - send ack after triage slot confirmed; Tanya - coordinate exec note if needed; Priya - lead triage and daily syncs until unblocked.

Jules M: Thanks team. Please keep updates concise here; escalate immediately if backfill failures exceed 20% or SSO errors spike.
